# Investor Loan Exchange

> A loan scenario exchange for investment-property lending. A broker submits one loan scenario; it is checked against each lender's niche (product, state, property type, loan size); every fitting lender receives one structured rate request; quotes come back to one place, side by side, and the broker chooses who to engage. People and AI agents use the same intake.

## What agents can do here

- Read the scenario format and submit a loan scenario on a broker's behalf, field for field, through the same intake form people use.
- One submission per deal. Scenarios only - never personal documents.
- The contact fields carry the broker's or borrower's details, not the agent's. Name the preparing agent in the notes field.
- Quotes and questions always go back to the person on the scenario. The agent prepares; the broker decides.
- Every submission is covered by the same consent: scenarios are shared with lenders only, and only with the submitter's consent.

## Lanes routed

DSCR rental, fix & flip, bridge, ground-up construction, cash-out refinance, and conforming (agency) for investment property. Owner-occupied conforming scenarios are reviewed by hand before any lender sees them.

- [scenario.schema.json](https://thehistoryhotseat.github.io/investor-loan-exchange/scenario.schema.json): JSON Schema for one loan scenario
- [Site](https://thehistoryhotseat.github.io/investor-loan-exchange/): full overview, lanes, lender onboarding, agent ground rules
